categories.title: Categories & Rules
categories.description: These are the categories the app uses to classify your transactions. You can add custom rules to improve categorization.
categories.matchHelp_SMART: Works even if the bank description varies slightly. Recommended.
categories.matchHelp_CONTAINS: Description must include this text exactly as written.
categories.matchHelp_STARTS_WITH: Description must begin with this text.
categories.matchHelp_ENDS_WITH: Description must end with this text.
categories.matchHelp_EXACT: Matches only if the description is exactly this text, word for word.
categories.matchHelp_REGEX: Advanced: use a regular expression pattern. Example: 'amazon|amzn' matches both 'AMAZON' and 'AMZN MKTP'.
categories.confirmDeleteRule: Are you sure you want to delete this rule?
categories.confirmDeleteCategory: Are you sure? This will also delete all rules for this category.
categories.alwaysActiveNote: These categories are always active. Pocket automatically assigns them based on your transaction descriptions. You can add custom rules to fine-tune how transactions are categorized.
categories.customRulesDescription: Add keywords to override how specific transactions are categorized.
categories.noCustomRules: No custom rules yet. Add one to override categorization for specific merchants.
categories.customCategoriesDescription: Create entirely new categories with your own name and rules. These appear in your dashboard alongside the standard ones.
categories.overrideHelp: If a transaction description contains any of these words, it will be classified under the selected category, overriding the default rules.
categories.customCategoryHelp: This category will appear in your dashboard alongside the standard ones. Transactions matching your keywords will be assigned here first, before standard rules are checked.
